subject: Hybrid Onramp: Request for Credit Exception & Bulk Conversion Path
messages:
From: Sam Reynolds <sam@olivelabs.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Cc: billing@olivelabs.com
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Accelerator top-up + special conversion path

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the product demo last week — the team at Olive Labs is excited about faster inference and the batching controls you showed. We're in the middle of a cohort program that would be a great fit for Redwood, but the standard starter credit isn't quite enough for the pilot workload.

Two asks from our side:
- A one-time accelerator top-up of free credits (we're estimating ~200k tokens of usage over the 3-month pilot).
- A promotional clause that lets us apply a portion of any unused credits as a credit toward a Dedicated commitment if we convert within our pilot window. This helps our CFO justify the pilot because it reduces stranded spend risk.

We can share the cohort SOW and expected consumption pattern — attaching the draft SOW and a brief usage spreadsheet. Ideally we'd like the top-up to be valid for at least 9 months and have a clear conversion mechanic rather than a refund.

Can you tell us what exceptions are possible for accelerator customers? We're flexible on mutual action plan and are happy to commit to a post-pilot evaluation call.

Best,
Sam
Sam Reynolds
Head of Platform & Partnerships
Olive Labs
Attachments: SOW-Draft-OLV.pdf (draft), usage-estimates.csv
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Sam Reynolds <sam@olivelabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Accelerator top-up + special conversion path

Sam — great to hear and congrats on the cohort acceptance. Quick notes and proposed next steps: 

1) High level approach: we can offer a conditional accelerator top-up + a conversion credit that applies toward a future Dedicated commitment. There are a few levers we usually use (expiry window, percent convertible, and minimum conversion commitment).

2) Proposed starting point (draft, subject to approvals):
   - Top-up: 200k token-equivalent credit, issued as a one-time promo credit.
   - Expiry: 9 months from issuance.
   - Conversion: up to 50% of remaining unused promo credit may be applied as a one-time credit against a Dedicated commitment if the customer signs a Dedicated agreement within 120 days of the pilot end.
   - If no conversion, remaining credits expire (no cash refund).

3) Ops + legal needs: procurement details, billing entity, and SOC2/audit contact for Private/Dedicated questions. Irené, can you advise on implications for billing amendments here? Ben — assigning to you to size the credit and prepare numbers we can communicate.

Next step: Ben will send a one-line offer and a credit worksheet; I'll follow with contract language for the amendment. If that sounds ok, Sam — can you confirm the billing entity and preferred invoice timing?

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Sam Reynolds <sam@olivelabs.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 6 Jun 2026 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Accelerator top-up + special conversion path

Sam / Hannah — looping in Lauren for billing ops. Attached is a quick worksheet with the proposed top-up and a couple of conversion scenarios so finance has a deterministic path. Bottom line proposal:

- Issue 200k token-equivalent promo credit today.
- Expiry: 9 months.
- Conversion mechanic: if Olive signs Dedicated within 120 days after pilot end, Redwood will allow conversion of up to 50% of remaining promo credit as a one-time account credit toward the first Dedicated invoice (applied as prepayment credit).
- Alternative (less favorable to Redwood): allow rollover up to 25% for 12 months — this would require accounting approval and a small processing fee.

I've attached MA-OLV-v1-credits.xlsx with both the token breakdown and an estimated dollar equivalence under two hosting scenarios (hosted vs dedicated). Lauren — can you confirm whether finance is comfortable with the 9-month expiry + 50% convertible approach, or if they need a deposit/fee to offset potential revenue leakage?

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Attachments: MA-OLV-v1-credits.xlsx
From: Olive Labs Billing <billing@olivelabs.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 09:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Accelerator top-up + special conversion path

Thanks Ben — appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple of clarifying items from our finance team: 

- Can the expiry be extended to 12 months instead of 9? Our pilots occasionally slip and the cohort has a rolling start.
- If credits are convertible, can we request that up to 75% of remaining credits be considered for conversion (we're trying to minimize stranded spend risk).
- If conversion does not occur, can any remaining credits be rolled forward for a one-time fee rather than fully forfeited?

Also, what's the invoicing cadence if we convert? We prefer a single up-front invoice for the first month of Dedicated with the promo credit applied as a prepayment.

Happy to have a short call if that helps.

—Sam
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Sam Reynolds <sam@olivelabs.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 15:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Accelerator top-up + special conversion path

Thanks for the clarity, Sam — appreciate the flexibility. Short summary of a compromise we can operationalize quickly (Hannah -> Olive Labs):

- Promo credit: 200k token-equivalent issued as a one-time promo on Olive Labs account.
- Expiry: 9 months standard; exception granted to 12 months for this cohort pilot (one-time concession).
- Conversion: up to 50% of remaining unused promo credit may be converted to a credit toward a Dedicated commitment if signed within 120 days after pilot end. We cannot extend conversion to 75% without a guaranteed minimum spend; however, we can offer 50% + option to roll forward an additional 25% subject to a 10% processing fee and accounting approval.
- Invoicing/Timing: if conversion occurs, promo credit will be applied as a prepayment credit to the first Dedicated invoice. Net30 terms for any remaining balance.
- Next steps: legal will draft a short amendment to the trial SOW reflecting the 12-month expiry and conversion mechanic; Ben/Finance to confirm final dollar equivalence and Lauren to confirm accounting flow.

@Sam — can you confirm the billing entity name and the legal contact for the SOW so we can route the amendment? Happy to schedule a 20-minute call if that speeds things up.

Cheers,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference — Partner Success
